summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects, but there are concerns about functional completeness and potential backend changes.

issues.description: The PR does not address how the antialiasing state should be handled in different backends. It currently uses the global rcParams, which may not be consistent with other artist behaviors.
There are no tests added to verify the new get/set_antialiased methods. This increases the risk of regressions or incorrect behavior.
The PR does not update the documentation for the Text class to include the new methods, which could lead to confusion for users.
